title: vpn_add, vpn_enable, vpn_disable and vpn_delete ask every time and the

clauses.text: vpn_add, vpn_enable, vpn_disable and vpn_delete ask every time and the list shows no keys

steps.do: Ask the assistant to list VPN profiles, then add one from your own file, then turn it on and off.
steps.expect: The list shows no keys; each change asks first and a key pasted into the chat is refused.
